mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.1% signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle that reduces discount rates for equity valuations and increases liquidity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.0%, it indicates severe labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing supply constraints (INDPRO below 100) signal production bottlenecks that increase input costs and reduce corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO remains below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%) signals imminent monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate improving consumer confidence and economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing manufacturing production (INDPRO) signals industrial expansion that boosts corporate output and earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rises in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.
